text:
Type: tall clear glass vase
Use: holding tall flowers or branches on a table, sideboard or floor; living room, dining room, hallway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: clear glass with a thick heavy base
Colors: transparent clear glass
Shape: tall tapered tumbler shape that widens toward the open top, straight sides, plain rim, sturdy weighted bottom, simple and versatile
Feel: fresh, light, clean
Goes with: any palette, white walls, wood tables, green branches; minimalist, Scandinavian or contemporary rooms
